name: Backbeat
feature_notes: Brassline spaces out its animated mini-games across six cabinets. A winning nudge pays the line award immediately. The next four paid spins after a mini-game stay on the reels across cabinet changes. Piggy’s three keys still unlock a free five-line spin.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.

install_step: In Fleet Arcade, open Brassline and choose any cabinet. After an animated mini-game, play four paid spins across any combination of cabinets. All four should remain on the reels.
